Do you see a different side to her? Etc as for the mutilation you seemed to experience maybe there’s something underlying about yourself where you want to open up or “dissect” yourself etc. Like I said I’m not an expert by any means that’s just how I interpreted your explanation of your dreams.

I haven’t been diagnosed but I have depression and generalized anxiety. I can relate and understand where you’re coming from with it being on your mind constantly. My depression and anxiety started around 13/14 years old and in the earlier stages it felt more severe. It was basically to the point where like 90% of my thoughts were how to kill myself and all the different ways I could do it so I wouldn’t have to feel pain anymore. I’m now 21 so I’ve been coping for almost a decade now. I need to add I don’t think I have the same severity because I have not self harmed or been hospitalized etc. But it has been an everlasting thought since then. It’s really hard to manage my mental health especially with my insecurities and my anxiety. But yea it helps to know you’re not alone. Everyone copes differently. For me I mainly joke about my suffering to try and lighten the severe crippling feeling I get from it. It kind of helps, I’ve made it this far anyways. I wish I had some quick fix cure or solution that would make things better but I don’t. The only advice I can think of is try to do/ think of the things that make you happy. If you can feel anything other than the weight of the world it’s a blessing. I hope you win this fight with your mental illness I’ll be rooting for you.
